hero.subtitle: Drone mission planning, autonomous docking stations, RTK survey, GIS and digital twins for inspection, mapping and site security.

challenge.title: The challenge in KSA
challenge.body: Industrial plants, pipelines, energy assets and giga-project sites cover huge areas. Ground patrols and manual inspections are slow, costly and sometimes unsafe, and progress reports rarely reflect what is really on the ground.
points: Large perimeters that patrols cannot cover continuously
Inspections at height or in harsh conditions

opportunity.title: The opportunity
opportunity.body: Autonomous drones and accurate geospatial data give continuous, repeatable coverage of sites and assets, with every flight captured as data you can compare over time.

capabilities.title: Mission planning and libraries
capabilities.body: Reusable RGB and thermal missions that fly the same route every time.

capabilities.title: Autonomous docking stations
capabilities.body: Ground, rooftop or vehicle-mounted docks for continuous site surveillance.

capabilities.title: RTK/GNSS survey
capabilities.body: Centimetre-level positioning for survey and mapping.

capabilities.title: GIS and digital twins
capabilities.body: Maps and 3D models that combine drone, survey and asset data.

capabilities.title: Robotics
capabilities.body: Air, land, surface and underwater robots for specialist inspection.

applications.title: Perimeter patrols
applications.body: Scheduled and on-demand patrols of industrial, energy and giga-project sites.

applications.title: Asset and pipeline inspection
applications.body: Thermal and visual inspection without scaffolding or shutdowns.

applications.title: Construction progress
applications.body: Regular aerial surveys compared against plan.

applications.title: Corridor mapping
applications.body: Roads, rail, power lines and pipelines mapped end to end.

applications.title: Event-area awareness
applications.body: Situational overview for large events and venues.

vision2030.body: Geospatial intelligence supports the delivery of giga-projects and the safe operation of national infrastructure.
programs: National Industrial Development and Logistics Program

deployment.note: Flight data and models stored in-Kingdom or on-premise. Operations follow GACA regulations.

extras.title: Operations and permits
items: Flights planned and operated in line with GACA regulations
Surveillance, survey and site-security use only
